# MindLeverX

> An evidence-led generative engine optimization practice for B2B SaaS.

Own the answer.

## Audit and availability

A paid audit starts with agreed questions, collection conditions, exclusions and a fixed quote before payment. {{AVAILABILITY}} {{ENQUIRY_STATUS}}

## Method

Preserve sources, collection dates and limitations. Review technical access, content quotability, off-site evidence and AI-answer visibility separately. Missing evidence is not zero. Model-API results are distinct from observations of consumer products. The owner approves the report revision before private delivery. Implementation and repeat monitoring are separate decisions.
